description: INNOVATIVE, ALL-ELECTRIC, LOCAL TRADE-IN, NONSMOKER, EFFORTLESS LUXURY AWAITS! The 2022 BMW iX xDrive50 represents BMW's boldest reimagining of what an electric SUV can be, blending genuine long-range capability with the kind of interior craftsmanship and technology that defines the brand's flagship vehicles. This isn't an existing model converted to electric power. It's a purpose-built electric platform from the ground up. BMW calls the iX a Sports Activity Vehicle, or SAV, the same designation the brand uses across its SUV lineup to reflect a driving character that leans more engaging and car-like than a traditional SUV. Paired with BMW's xDrive all-wheel-drive system, this iX delivers confident, predictable traction regardless of road conditions, while its dual-motor layout gives it genuinely quick, effortless acceleration. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The iX represents BMW's first ground-up electric SUV, and shoppers consistently seek it out for the combination of genuine long-range capability, a remarkably quiet, comfortable cabin, and driving dynamics that feel distinctly more engaging than most electric SUVs in its class. Its carbon-fiber-reinforced passenger cell and aluminum spaceframe construction also give it a lighter, more efficient structure than a conventional steel-bodied SUV of similar size. Buyers are also drawn to the iX's genuinely fast DC charging capability, which allows it to add significant range in a relatively short stop, making it one of the more road-trip-friendly electric SUVs on the market. That combination of range, refinement, and charging speed has helped the iX build a strong reputation among luxury EV shoppers. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Reviewers have consistently praised the iX for its remarkably quiet, refined cabin at highway speeds, along with real-world range that frequently exceeds its official EPA rating in independent testing. Its dual-motor all-wheel-drive powertrain has also drawn praise for delivering strong, immediate acceleration without sacrificing the comfortable, composed ride buyers expect from a flagship BMW SUV. Frequently cited by independent testers for exceeding its EPA-rated range in real-world highway driving Recognized among the quietest and most refined electric SUVs in its class WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 41,067-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage High-Voltage Battery Limited Warranty -- Covers defects in materials or workmanship for the high-voltage lithium-ion battery assembly. Expiration: 06/22/2030 or 100,000 miles, whichever comes first. Extended service plans may also be available to provide additional peace of mind throughout your ownership experience. STANDARD FEATURES The xDrive50 sits at the heart of the iX lineup, pairing dual electric motors with BMW's intelligent all-wheel-drive system for confident, all-weather traction alongside genuinely strong performance. Every iX also comes with BMW's signature focus on cabin refinement, from its sustainably sourced interior materials to its remarkably quiet operation at highway speeds. Buyers consistently choose the xDrive50 for its well-rounded balance of range, performance, and everyday usability, positioned as the sweet spot in the iX lineup before stepping up to the more performance-focused M60. INSTALLED OPTIONS This iX was extensively factory-optioned with four major packages along with several standalone upgrades, giving it a noticeably more complete and personalized configuration than a standard xDrive50. Premium Package BMW Live Cockpit Pro with enhanced digital displays Head-Up Display with video augmented reality Surround View with 3D View camera system harman/kardon surround sound system Personal eSIM with 5G connectivity Interior camera and Natural Interaction gesture control Multi-functional front seats Drive Recorder and Remote Theft Recorder Iconic Sounds Electric exterior and interior sound design Parking Assistant Plus Dynamic Handling Package Integral Active Steering for improved low-speed maneuverability and high-speed stability Two-axle air suspension for a smoother, more adaptable ride Sport Package Sport-tuned chassis calibration 21'' x 9.5'' Aero Bi-Color wheels (Style 1012) 255/50R21 all-season, non run-flat tires Luxury Package Soft-close automatic doors Glass-finished controls with walnut wood console trim Standalone Features Icon Adaptive LED headlights with Laserlight Active Driving Assistant Pro Front ventilated seats Castanea Chestnut, olive-leaf-tanned leather upholstery CHARGING, RANGE & ELECTRIFIED POWERTRAIN The iX xDrive50 pairs a 111.5 kWh battery pack with dual electric motors producing a combined 516 horsepower and 564 lb-ft of torque, delivering genuinely quick, effortless acceleration without any of the noise or vibration of a traditional engine. On this vehicle's 21'' wheels, the iX carries an EPA-estimated range of approximately 305 miles per charge. Level 1 and Level 2 AC charging handle everyday overnight charging with ease, while DC fast charging is where this iX truly shines. Capable of accepting up to 195 kW, this iX can add roughly 100 miles of range in as little as 13 minutes under ideal conditions, with a 10 percent to 80 percent charge taking approximately 40 minutes. MECHANICAL FEATURES The iX's dual-motor setup delivers power instantly and smoothly, with BMW's xDrive system continuously adjusting the torque split between the front and rear motors to maximize traction and stability in any condition. The result is a driving experience that feels distinctly more athletic than most electric SUVs its size. With the Dynamic Handling Package's Integral Active Steering and two-axle air suspension, this iX offers noticeably sharper low-speed maneuverability along with a smoother, more adaptable ride than a standard-suspension iX, allowing the chassis to adjust to changing road conditions and driving styles automatically. EXTERIOR FEATURES The iX's closed-off kidney grille is one of the more fascinating pieces of engineering on this vehicle, and it isn't there for cooling at all. Because an electric powertrain needs only minimal airflow, BMW repurposed the grille as what it calls an intelligence panel, embedding the front camera, radar sensors, and their heating and cleaning mechanisms behind a transparent, digitally functional surface rather than a traditional set of vents. To protect that sensor housing, BMW applies a nanoscale vacuum-coated polyurethane finish over the grille that gives it a genuinely unusual party trick: it can heal itself. Minor scratches and light surface damage gradually disappear on their own, typically within about 24 hours at room temperature, or in as little as five minutes when exposed to warm air, such as a hair dryer held a few inches away. It's the kind of quietly clever engineering BMW refers to as shy tech, functionality built in subtly enough that most owners never notice it until the day they need it. Beyond the grille, the Icon Adaptive LED headlights with Laserlight extend high-beam range significantly further than conventional LED lighting, while the Sport Package's 21'' Aero Bi-Color wheels add a distinctly more athletic stance without meaningfully compromising the iX's efficiency-focused aerodynamics. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, the Castanea Chestnut, olive-leaf-tanned leather upholstery brings a distinctly sustainable yet genuinely upscale character to the cabin, reflecting BMW's broader push toward more environmentally conscious luxury materials. The Luxury Package's walnut wood console trim and glass-finished controls further elevate the cabin's tactile quality well beyond a standard iX. Multi-functional front seats, now ventilated as well as heated, keep both front occupants comfortable in any season, while the soft-close automatic doors add a final touch of effortless refinement every time you enter or exit. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY BMW's Live Cockpit Pro anchors the cabin with expansive digital displays and an intuitive interface, further enhanced by a Head-Up Display with video augmented reality that overlays navigation guidance directly onto the road ahead. A Personal eSIM with 5G connectivity keeps this iX connected to BMW's cloud-based services without relying on a paired smartphone. The harman/kardon surround sound system delivers genuinely premium audio, while Iconic Sounds Electric gives this iX a distinctive, purpose-designed sound signature both inside and outside the cabin. Natural Interaction gesture and voice control further simplify everyday operation without taking hands off the wheel. SAFETY FEATURES Active Driving Assistant Pro brings a comprehensive suite of advanced driver-assistance technology to this iX, including adaptive cruise control and lane-centering assistance designed to reduce driver fatigue on longer drives. Surround View with 3D View gives the driver a genuinely clear picture of the vehicle's surroundings when parking or maneuvering in tight spaces. Parking Assistant Plus further simplifies parallel and perpendicular parking, while the Drive Recorder and Remote Theft Recorder add an extra layer of security and peace of mind for owners. ... and there's SO MUCH more!
